scope: A newly accepted native melee attack receives a fresh native geometry check. No cached warning replay. Stop/reload/restart target attempts must each produce attributable native, modern and stock range feedback.
preserve: Original offline identities, complete saved/inventory/pet state, money, saved primary user pose and five protected actors.
limits: Normal core update may also emit its first deduplicated warning. This does not qualify continuous error cadence, moving targets, abilities or hostile combat.
